prompt.zh-CN: 命题“如果下雨，那么地面会湿”的逆否命题是哪一个？
prompt.en-US: What is the contrapositive of 'If it rains, then the ground is wet'?

text.zh-CN: 如果地面湿，那么下雨了
text.en-US: If the ground is wet, then it rained

text.zh-CN: 如果地面不湿，那么没有下雨
text.en-US: If the ground is not wet, then it did not rain

text.zh-CN: 如果没有下雨，那么地面不湿
text.en-US: If it did not rain, then the ground is not wet

text.zh-CN: 地面会自己讲天气预报
text.en-US: The ground gives its own weather forecast

reveal.zh-CN: “如果 P 则 Q”的逆否命题是“如果非 Q 则非 P”，且与原命题等价。
reveal.en-US: The contrapositive of 'if P then Q' is 'if not Q then not P,' and it is logically equivalent.

prompt.zh-CN: “有门票是入场的必要条件”表示什么？
prompt.en-US: What does it mean that having a ticket is a necessary condition for entry?

text.zh-CN: 有门票就一定能飞起来
text.en-US: With a ticket, you can definitely fly
Without a ticket, you cannot enter

reveal.zh-CN: 必要条件是结果成立时必须具备的条件，但具备它未必一定足够。
reveal.en-US: A necessary condition must be present for the result, but it may not be sufficient by itself.

prompt.zh-CN: 判断：两个现象同时增加，就一定说明其中一个导致另一个。
prompt.en-US: True or false: if two phenomena increase together, one must have caused the other.

reveal.zh-CN: 相关性可能来自因果、共同原因、偶然或统计偏差，不能直接等同于因果。
reveal.en-US: Correlation can arise from causation, a common cause, chance, or bias, so it is not automatically causation.

prompt.zh-CN: 选择题中使用排除法，本质上是在做什么？
prompt.en-US: When using elimination in a multiple-choice question, what are you essentially doing?

text.en-US: Painting all options the same color

text.zh-CN: 先识别不可能或明显错误的选项
text.en-US: First identifying impossible or clearly wrong options
Only looking at the longest word

reveal.zh-CN: 排除法不能替代理解，但能降低候选范围，适合和正向推理结合。
reveal.en-US: Elimination does not replace understanding, but it narrows candidates and works well with direct reasoning.

prompt.zh-CN: 要推翻“所有天鹅都是白色的”这个全称命题，最需要什么？
prompt.en-US: To disprove the universal claim 'All swans are white,' what do you need most?

text.en-US: One hundred photos of white swans

text.zh-CN: 一个不是白色的天鹅反例
text.en-US: One counterexample of a swan that is not white

reveal.zh-CN: 全称命题只要出现一个真实反例就被推翻。
reveal.en-US: A universal claim is disproved by a single real counterexample.
